pattern: \$700,000[^.]{0,160}\b(?:buyers have the edge|buyer'?s market)\b|\b(?:buyers have the edge|buyer'?s market)\b[^.]{0,160}\$700,000
struck: Houses at $700,000 and up have about 7 months: the one part of the house market where buyers have the edge.
use: Houses at $700,000 and up have about 7 months of supply, at the top of the balanced range: the one part of the house market near the point where buyers gain the edge.

struck: Condos in the City of Myrtle Beach have about 18 months of supply; houses there 5.3 months.
use: Condos in the City of Myrtle Beach have about 11 to 12 months of supply, about a year; houses there about 5 to 6.

struck: A new house is not a premium here: it costs less than a resale.
use: The middle home a builder sold, condos aside, went for about $330,000; the middle resale house or other home about $350,000.

struck: Resale closings are fewest in January and February and most from May through July; the middle price barely moves.
use: Recorded resales were fewest in January and February (about 430 houses a month) and ran about 620 to 670 a month from May to October.

struck: Across Horry County, the middle resale house sold for about $350,000.
use: Across Horry County, the middle resale house or other home sold for about $350,000, and the middle resale condo about $215,000.

struck: About 3 in 10 homes sold went to a buyer whose tax bill goes to another state.
use: About 3 in 10 homes sold went to a buyer whose tax bill goes to another state or country; for condos, more than half.

struck: Out-of-state buyers do not pay more.
use: In the same building or subdivision, buyers with an out-of-state tax bill paid the same middle price as South Carolina buyers; the records show no sign that they pay more.

pattern: \b52 percent\b|\brose 0\.8 percent\b|\bpeaked in the third quarter\b
struck: House prices in the Myrtle Beach metro rose 0.8 percent in the year to mid-2026, after rising 52 percent in the five years before.
use: The federal house price index for Horry County rose about 51 percent from mid-2021 to mid-2025. In the year to mid-2026 it was about flat (up 0.8 percent, less than the index's margin).

struck: That is why we line one up on every purchase.
use: We line up the inspection.

struck: When one comes in low, we send the appraiser comparable sales and ask for a reconsideration of value.
use: When one comes in low, we send comparable sales with a request for a reconsideration of value.

struck: The buyer has the right to a free copy, no later than three days before closing.
use: You get a free copy as soon as it is done, or three business days before closing if that is sooner, unless you agree in advance to get it at closing.

pattern: \bfor a home (?:you live in|to live in)\b[^.]{0,160}\battorney|\battorney\b[^.]{0,160}\bfor a home (?:you live in|to live in)\b
struck: When you buy with a home loan for a home to live in, the lender must ask which attorney you want for the closing.
use: When you buy with a home loan for personal or family use, the lender must ask which attorney you want for the closing and follow your choice.

struck: A South Carolina notary must be in the room with the signer.
use: A South Carolina notary and the signer must be in each other's physical presence; South Carolina law has no remote (video) notarization.

struck: The county charges $15 to record a deed and $25 to record a mortgage.
use: Recording costs $15 for a deed and $25 for a mortgage, fees set by state law.

struck: On a $350,000 house, 2026 property tax outside city limits is about $1,290 a year as your legal residence.
use: On a house the county values at $350,000, 2026 property tax outside city limits is about $1,290 a year as your legal residence and about $4,220 as a second home.

struck: The middle Horry County house costs about $7,550 a year besides the mortgage, about $630 a month (HOA about $900).
use: The middle Horry County house costs about $7,850 a year besides the mortgage, about $650 a month (HOA about $1,200).

struck: In North Myrtle Beach the middle condo costs about $11,240 a year against $7,970 for the middle house.
use: In North Myrtle Beach the middle condo costs about $11,240 a year against $7,670 for the middle house.

struck: North Myrtle Beach allows short-term rentals with a business licence and has no zoning map for them.
use: In North Myrtle Beach a short-term rental needs a business licence, and for now there is no special zoning or permit process beyond it.

struck: The due diligence period usually runs 10 to 14 days, and walking away costs the termination fee.
use: (cut it: owner question 1 is open; say only what we do in that time)

struck: Most purchases close in 30 to 45 days; cash in about two weeks.
use: (cut it: owner question 3 is open; give the two federal waits only)
